Elon Musk said Colossus 2, the AI computing cluster developed by his xAI business, could more than double its current number of Nvidia
chips by the end of the year.
CEO gave the most detailed timetable yet for expansion plans for the Memphis-area cluster as he races to expand AI computing capacity.

Colossus 2 now has 110,000 Nvidia GB200 chips and 440,000 GB300s, Musk said in a post on X. A further 220,000 GB300s are due to be operational next week, with another 220,000 expected in November, he said. An additional 220,000 may come online late December “if we get lucky,” he added.
unit previously said it plans to equip its Memphis facility with 1 million graphics processing units by 2026.

title: Elon Musk eyes doubling xAI's Colossus 2 Nvidia AI chips by year-end
